nom: medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Night Wrapping Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with skin not normally prone to oiliness reports the mask made it excessively oily and advises against it for normal-to-oily skin.
segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry skin report increased hydration, softness, and moisture lock-in overnight, with one calling it a game changer for dry combination skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry combination skin reports hydrated, soft skin as a repeat benefit.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report irritation, itchy red patches, or a burning sensation on peeling, with one explicitly warning sensitive-skin users away.
segments.mature: One reviewer flags the retinol content as something younger users should avoid, implying suitability skews toward mature skin with sun protection.

concerns.aging: One reviewer notes the mask contains retinol and recommends sunscreen and moisturizer use, positioning it as an anti-aging step best suited to non-younger skin.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report hydrated, soft, plump skin the next morning, including one with dry skin describing it as a game changer for moisture.
concerns.redness: One reviewer's sister experienced itchy red patches and irritation described as an allergic-type reaction.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes a painful, chemical-burn-like sensation when peeling the mask off, suggesting barrier discomfort for some users.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say it faded dark marks and hyperpigmentation and evened skin tone, while at least two say it did nothing for their dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-related reports are negative: multiple reviewers describe new breakouts including cystic acne after use, though a few acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and even improvement or scar fading.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer not usually prone to oiliness reports the mask left skin very oily and unsuitable for normal-to-oily skin types.

extraits.titre: Not worth the hype — AVOID IF ACNE PRONE!
extraits.texte: I was excited to try this. It had been hyped up online, however after many attempts, I was left with worse skin than before. I have acne prone skin, and I was told this could be beneficial. The first few times I tried it, I had difficulty with it peeling off during the night. I never saw beneficial results within the first few attempts, but I gave it a few more tries to allow time to see. Every time I've tried using this it leaves a greasy, almost sticky, feeling even after hours of drying. It's weird and uncomfortable to sleep in. I started to notice acne popping up after utilizing this. Some of what popped up was just small, typical looking zits, or closed comedones. But then I noticed deep seeded, almost cystic acne, popping up. The acne I was getting from this product has been a nightmare to clear up. Deep seeded cysts that take weeks to heal, and seem to come back even after clearing. Never had issues like this till I used this product… AVOID IF ACNE PRONE!! Love medicube, and this has been my only flop from them, but it wont stop me from using their other products, not everything is acne safe and I understand that. I just want to spread this to help other acne prone people out there.
